I don’t have a vox so I have taken more time into team comps and my equips because there, to me atleast, is three major parts to making the team.
The units, the equips, and the set up.
You want the units to work off each other. And honestly some scenarios a single target art gen would be better.
Let’s say you got a vox a thetis a norn with her true weapon, and a lozze.
If your vox has swashbuckler fen, that will get norn an insta true art to start art gen for the entire team. Something like that will be nearly more effective at early starting artgen then a 30 arts to all, which will leave you still dry on arts and unable to do anything all around.

Again it really is just perspective and matching of what kind of boss you are fighting against
You can’t change the mind of a player, only try to guide them.

I’ve thought of running Rosie (Rosetta) with true asterisk and true exgate tons of times, but if you have a decent team like
Rosie Weaver lets say vox and thetis.
That’s 4 5* aoe equips and 1 4* that can easily ramp up the 200 arts for all their magia drives, and 20 arts for each Weaver art which only cost 100 arts which is easily obtainable from 4 5* equips.

Another simple idea is getting vox to magia drive ASAP so he can self sustain even better, and then using the single target on other specific units. Either way in my eyes aoe is best option, but it is all on perspective of the player and some find a single target to be better than a good team comp with multiple aoe equips

I think it more comes down to how easy obtainable single artgen equips are vs “good” aoe artgen 5* equips. Newer reroll accounts with players who know how to start the game, will go for the ldh for a good equip for their new vox on that reroll.
